key_insight: A projectability-guided AO construction can turn plane-wave DFT outputs into compact Hamiltonian learning targets while preserving nonlocal hybrid-functional effects.
engineering_relevance: This enables accurate, smaller-basis training data for neural-network Hamiltonian models, making plane-wave DFT workflows more practical for scalable electronic-structure prediction.
method: Select high-projectability PW eigenstates as the core AO subspace.
Add selected higher-energy states to complete the subspace without using an empirical shift.
Build nonorthogonal AO Hamiltonians directly from PW eigenvalues and eigenstates, retaining nonlocal operator contributions implicitly.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks on MoS2 and sodium phases show the constructed PBE and HSE Hamiltonians reproduce PW band structures accurately with smaller AO bases than real-space reconstruction.
watch_item: The approach depends on careful state selection and projectability thresholds, so robustness may vary across materials with different band entanglement or basis requirements.
paper_title: Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
